head: 9ec9317ced38f40e490aeb5c6ab5f45859fe1611
deviations: Cooks the engine's own tets as both collision and simulation mesh (preferred path, no fallback built), from the WORLD-space rest shape via SoftBodies::OrientTets, so mirrored/non-uniform scales need no PxDeformableVolumeExt::transform; driver CreateVolume takes world rest positions + oriented tets, not TetMeshData
Skinning shared via new engine/softbody/TetSkinning.hpp (SkinSurface); CpuSoftBodyBackend now calls it, its orientation/volume setup is left as is (OrientTets duplicates the same sign test)
IDeformableDriver adds GetNodeMap (cooked vertex order) and ReadBack(id, simVelocities); no GetSceneGravity (gravity is the scene's)
Handle indexes are never reused (slot reuse = the volume room is freed on Destroy), so a stale handle cannot alias a new body
Density is read at body creation only (changing a live body's mass would need a full sim-state readback)
Mapping: damping -> body linear damping (elasticity damping fixed 0); PhysX position iterations = solverIterations*4 clamped to 255; ground plane/groundHeight/gravity ignored on GPU

A body the CPU would also refuse (null mesh, >kMaxTetsPerBody, non-finite transform) is refused without failing the feature; a driver refusal incl. the 4095 limit fails it (FailSoftBodies, one warning, CPU restart)
FailSoftBodies now also ReleaseAll()s the backend; InstallDeformableDriverForTesting only sets _gpuStatus Ready if not already Ready
SoftMaterialModel moved to engine/physics/SoftMaterialModel.hpp; materialModel/selfCollision added to SoftBodyParams

FakePhysicsBackend gained UseDeformableSoftBodies (real DeformableSoftBodyBackend over a fake driver); PhysXBackend tests avoid Update() with a fake particle driver installed (CPU scene would get a particle sync); existing GpuProbeTests soft-body test renamed
docs: docs/README.md, index.html, testing.html also updated; checklist adds its own temporary lua_project jelly snippet since no soft-body station exists

Review fixes: Upload wakes the volume (static_cast<PxDeformableBody&>.setWakeCounter(0.4f), header-verified) when velocities are pushed, FakeDeformableDriver counts wakes; setSolverIterationCounts called through PxDeformableBody& (non-deprecated overload); checklist drop height corrected to 6.5 m and a step noting the AddVelocity push hits a body at rest ~4 s; the read-back-without-particle-sync case is NOT an automated golden case (the particle system always exists on a GPU scene and cannot be dropped reliably): it is a manual checklist step (section 4) and stays unverified until observed on a GPU.
unverified: Real CUDA/PhysX: volume creation from the cooked mesh (same tets as collision+simulation mesh with buildGPUData) accepted by a GPU scene; cooking vertex order on real meshes
fetchResults(true) alone making device buffers safe to read; read-back timing/cost; VRAM; perf with N bodies and with particles in one scene; one PhysXGpu module for particles and deformables

PGS solver quality; CoRotational/NeoHookean stability on real meshes; parameter mapping quality vs CPU; release order of actor/shape/material/mesh/pinned memory; DLL-missing behaviour; whether a soft body pushes Rigidbodies; PhysXGpuSoftBodiesGoldenTest itself (skipped in CI)
needsUser: Hold for the user: run PhysXGpuSoftBodiesGoldenTest.* and docs/gpu-softbodies-checklist.html on the Windows GPU PC and report before ratify/merge
